searchText: Coinbase did an A/B test and found 9% fee savings and faster inclusion for 1559 transactions. You might get different results on different platforms but pretty good still IMO https://blog.coinbase.com/the-technical-benefits-of-eip-1559-c41bb85f5924 This claim rests on the likely untrue assumption that the auction is a perfect information game with all perfectly rational actor participants.
